cards.title: Cooperative histogram prefix scan
affected_estimators: Symmetric single-target GBDT classifiers
Symmetric single-target GBDT regressors
Ordered single-target GBDT when using pointwise histogram search
cards.mechanism: B assigns one complete feature/partition/fold to a 128-thread block, scans each statistic plane in 128-bin shared-memory tiles using a barrier-uniform inclusive scan, and carries each tile sum forward. A assigns one thread per feature and serially scans bins. One-hot and zero/one-bin features preserve their skip behavior; padded lanes never load/store histogram tails.
prerequisites: Pointwise histogram scan route must be active
Keep MOJOLEARN_SYM_SCAN_SUB_FUSED absent in both arms to cover partial-pass scans; it bypasses the separate scan
Same feature policies, borders, hist_count and split settings
limitations: FAST prefix association changes bits
One block per feature adds block scheduling/barrier cost for short slices; all feature widths must be covered
No fused scan/subtraction variant is introduced
All barriers are uniform by construction, but no compile or device evidence exists

cards.title: Four-row leaf-apply loop
affected_estimators: GBDT classifier/regressor training paths using partition-indexed add_model_value_kernel
Multidimensional/tree-objective callers of the same shared cursor-update kernel
cards.mechanism: B unrolls four independent grid-stride rows per leaf-update iteration. A leaf/dimension raw value and partition metadata are loaded once as before; four cursor operations share loop control and expose independent loads/stores. The outer stride becomes four grid strides, so every row appears once and odd tails are guarded. A keeps one row per iteration.
prerequisites: Partition-indexed add_model_value_kernel route
Same launch geometry, leaf partition, dimensions and learning rate
No EST_REUSE_PART or EST_SHRINK_FUSED requirement
limitations: Only leaves exceeding a grid stride use multiple useful lanes of the tile; unchanged small-leaf work may be neutral
Launch count is unchanged
Cursor arithmetic retains identical_mul_add; no numerical accuracy claim is made without future evidence
cards.plan_revision: Existing kernel already hoists each leaf value; G08 adds independent grid-stride rows and loop unrolling instead of claiming a new metadata-hoisting optimization.

affected_estimators: Ordered single-target GBDT classifiers using batched one-step estimation/apply
Ordered single-target GBDT regressors using batched one-step estimation/apply
cards.mechanism: B applies four coalesced cursor rows per worker and quarters the corresponding apply grids (rounded up). Each worker caches the task lower/upper cursor offset while its increasing row positions remain in that task; a boundary crossing performs the original segment search again. Every row reads its own permutation, bin and leaf value. A retains the original single-row implementation.

Same prefix tasks, folds, permutations, leaf values and rate
